patch_description: Replace the clipped-ring construction with a feasible staggered lattice seed followed by deterministic nonlinear refinement of both centers and radii. The optimization uses the exact disk containment and pairwise non-overlap inequalities. A final linear program recomputes the best possible radii for the refined centers, which is more reliable than the former order-dependent pairwise shrinking routine and guarantees that the returned radii satisfy every center-distance constraint. A tiny safety factor makes the construction robust to floating-point validation tolerances.
